_comment: Run each query with the NBR_SALESFORCE soqlQuery tool after substituting {START} / {END} (UTC bounds of the IST day, e.g. 2026-10-19T18:30:00Z / 2026-10-20T18:30:00Z) and {DATE} (YYYY-MM-DD). Save each JSON response verbatim to data/<DATE>/<name>.json.
leads: SELECT OwnerId, Lead_Source__c, Lead_Sub_Source__c, COUNT(Id) c FROM Lead__c WHERE CreatedDate >= {START} AND CreatedDate < {END} GROUP BY OwnerId, Lead_Source__c, Lead_Sub_Source__c
calls_out: SELECT Call_From__c, Status__c, COUNT(Id) c, SUM(Duration_in_Minutes__c) m FROM Call_Detail__c WHERE Start_Time__c >= {START} AND Start_Time__c < {END} AND Call_Type__c = 'Outbound Call' GROUP BY Call_From__c, Status__c
calls_in: SELECT Call_To__c, Status__c, COUNT(Id) c, SUM(Duration_in_Minutes__c) m FROM Call_Detail__c WHERE Start_Time__c >= {START} AND Start_Time__c < {END} AND Call_Type__c != 'Outbound Call' GROUP BY Call_To__c, Status__c
lead_calls: SELECT Lead_custom__c, COUNT(Id) c FROM Call_Detail__c WHERE Start_Time__c >= {START} AND Start_Time__c < {END} AND Lead_custom__c != null GROUP BY Lead_custom__c
followups: SELECT Id, OwnerId, WhatId, Status FROM Task WHERE ActivityDate = {DATE} AND Subject LIKE 'Follow Up%' LIMIT 2000
site_visits: SELECT Id, OwnerId, Status__c, Lead__c, Lead__r.Lead_Source__c FROM Site_Visit__c WHERE Site_Visit_Start_Date_Time__c >= {START} AND Site_Visit_Start_Date_Time__c < {END} LIMIT 2000
walkin_visits: SELECT Id, OwnerId, Lead_Source__c FROM Lead__c WHERE Site_Visit_Done_Date__c = {DATE} LIMIT 2000
